fixtures.source: Synthetic FFmpeg testsrc2; no camera credentials or production recordings. Archive exact ffmpeg version/command, fixture hashes and ffprobe JSON.
audio_variants: AAC mono 48000 Hz 64000 bit/s synthetic sine
fixtures.network: RTSP over TCP on isolated test network; source generator off-target; record link speed/RTT/loss

storage.requirements: Dedicated disposable filesystem with at least 4 GiB free; record filesystem/device. Never production data.
storage.max_size_semantics: Unlimited application setting for bounded calibration workload; physical free space is checked and the scenario stops before exhaustion.

fixtures.detection: Baseline workload detection off. SOD/LiteRT/MQTT/archive production-feature scenarios measured separately, never claimed covered by idle/remux.

phases.browser: one Live view, four tiles; repeat Streams list/edit/save with synthetic tags every 30 seconds

workload.rationale: Protocol durations/counts are experimental settings, not measured acceptance limits. Five independent process runs expose run-to-run variance; ten-minute recording phases span at least ten segments. Revise workload with documented product reason before calibration.

provenance: exact source revision and clean tree

measurement_method.cold_cache: Browser: fresh user-data directory, clear HTTP cache/storage and disable cache for first navigation. NVR: fresh process and disposable DB; report OS page cache uncontrolled unless a dedicated target is rebooted under an approved protocol. Never drop host-wide caches.
measurement_method.warm_cache: Reuse the browser profile with caching enabled, reload once before sampling; reuse fixture filesystem cache while restarting NVR process. Label every sample; never combine cold and warm distributions.
measurement_method.nvr: Sample monotonic time, /proc/PID/stat utime+stime, /proc/PID/status VmRSS/VmHWM/Threads, and /proc/PID/fd count. CPU percent = delta_ticks / CLK_TCK / delta_monotonic_seconds * 100 (one core = 100%). Record child PIDs and start times; aggregate RSS explicitly (shared pages may be double counted) or use PSS where available.
measurement_method.browser: Use PerformanceObserver/navigation timing for navigation and long tasks, explicit marks around edit-open and save acknowledgement, video first decoded frame for Live, and browser process memory via OS counters. JS heap via Chromium CDP if available; report unavailable on other browsers, never zero.
measurement_method.recordings: ffprobe every committed segment, decode at least the first segment after each recovery. Check adjacent packet/media timestamps, playable codec, DB times and byte counts. Separate intentional outage from unexplained recording gaps.
measurement_method.comparison: Publish every run, median/p95/max per metric and cold/warm state; calculate candidate-minus-baseline on identical device, fixtures and feature flags with alternating baseline/candidate runs. Calibrate tolerances from repeated baseline variation and product recovery constraints, then review numeric limits before enabling a gate.
failure_rules: Unexpected process exit, sanitizer error, corrupt/undecodable recording or missing samples fails its scenario.
Unknown target, uncalibrated limit or unsupported metric remains unqualified.
Teardown records graceful deadline separately from fallback kill; a fallback kill is not successful shutdown.
Do not reuse production URLs, DB/storage, PID files, credentials or globally fixed ports.

method.cache: fresh database/process; OS page cache uncontrolled/warm
